title: Country
description: Country geographic, demographic, and administrative information including ISO codes, capital city, region, population, area, languages, currency, and timezone. Used for country databases, internationalization, and geographic applications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the country record

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter country code (e.g., US, GB, FR, DE)

code3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA, DEU)

capital.description: Name of the capital city of the country

region.description: Geographic region or continent (e.g., Europe, Asia, Americas, Africa)

subregion.description: Geographic subregion (e.g., Western Europe, South Asia, North America)

area.description: Total land area in square kilometers

languages.description: Array of official languages spoken in the country

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used in the country (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

timezone.description: Primary IANA timezone identifier for the country

flag.description: URL to the country's flag image
